fingerprint_method_note: Fingerprints exclude __pycache__/*.pyc (find ... ! -path '*__pycache__*' ! -name '*.pyc' | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum). Earlier fingerprints in this file's history included pycache artifacts, which caused false-positive drift signals when a local pytest run added/changed .pyc files under a source_paths directory with no real .py change -- recomputed clean as of the 2026-09-02 full documentation audit.
last_update_note: 2026-09-09 (two passes). Pass 1: targeted fold-in of RoadMap.md items 7 and 16-25 across all six sections.
